flags.summary: At the Aug. 13, 2026 board meeting, resident Jordan Black said in public comment that Bowyer had told him the board is a 'self-serving board' and that members will enact their own personal agendas; the Corydon Democrat reported the claim as Black's account and did not report a response from Bowyer to that specific claim.
flags.note: A secondhand account of a private remark by one speaker (who shares a surname with at-large candidate Ashley Black); not confirmed by Bowyer.

sources.title: North Harrison board finalizes classroom display policy

flags.summary: In his Sept. 2026 Corydon Democrat questionnaire, Schenck said the district's focus should be servant leadership, 'not ridicule, nepotism and party politics,' and accused board members and the superintendent of mismanagement; he gave no specific examples, and no response from the board or superintendent was published.
flags.note: An unspecified nepotism claim against current officials; the profile text keeps only his general management criticism.

sources.title: NH Jackson Township school board seat draws four (Chad Schenck questionnaire)
